info.name: 1Factory QMS API
info.description:
This API allows you to create and query a number of objects in your 1Factory account.

Contact Support:
 Name: API Support
 Email: support@1factory.com

item.name: 1Factory Gets a List of NCRs for Your Organization

query.description: Starting page for queried rows - defaults to 0 (the start of the list). Returned rows will start at index (page * page_size).
The maximum number of records to return from the query. Defaults to 100, maximum value 500.
Return objects created after the specified date-time
Return objects created before the specified date-time
Return objects updated after the specified date-time
Return objects updated before the specified date-time
Return only approved or rejected objects closed after the specified date-time.
Return only approved or rejected objects closed before the specified date-time.

request.description:
The list of NCRs can be filtered by specifying query parameters.

Paging parameters control the number of rows NCR objects returned. By default, the first 100 NCRs are returned.

response.name: Returns a list of NCRs, most recently created first. Utilize paging query parameters to query older NCRs. By default the 100 most recent are returned.
